about: repair_not_made, story E of the student simulation of 2026-10-06: an in-unit washer a roommate broke, still leaking after a repair; portal requests. On the code before 2026-10-08 the sheet asked "Was the problem caused by you, a member of your household, or someone you let in?", the student said yes for the roommate, and both repair options showed closed (TODO item 92). Since the sheet asks who caused it, a roommate is not settled under 83.51(4), so no reply may call the repair options closed. Sheet rules answer both the old questions and the new ones.
